video_title: Danilo Gallinari JOINS the BAHA 🔥 Did Kawhi change his CAREER 👀

quotes.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
quotes.summary_phrase: Danilo Gallinari on his best years in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Probably my third year in Denver before I tore my first ACL, I think I was in my prime.
quotes.quote: Probably my third year in Denver before I tore my first ACL, I think I was in my prime, body-wise, too. But then, of course, my year in LA with the Clippers, my second season with the Clippers, and my year in OKC for sure, were two of my best years. And then as far as team-wise, the farthest I got in the playoffs was in the Eastern Conference Finals when I was in Atlanta. I was coming from the bench, but it was definitely a great run.

quotes.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
quotes.summary_phrase: Danilo Gallinari clarifies his comments on Kawhi Leonard
quotes.excerpt: I didn't say I was the biggest, I was one of the biggest what-ifs.

text_blocks.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
text_blocks.text: I didn't say I was the biggest, I was one of the biggest what-ifs because I'm going to tell you my four what-ifs. What if I don't get injured my first year as a rookie in New York and I don't get back surgery my first year in New York? What if I don't tear my ACL in my prime, my third year in Denver, as the best player of the team and one of the best teams in the league? What if I don't tear my ACL in Boston and I miss the whole season in Boston? And the last what-if is, what if I don't miss eight summers with the Italian national team?

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Was it the same knee?

text_blocks.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
text_blocks.text: Same knee, same knee.

quotes.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
quotes.summary_phrase: Gallinari on the pressure to play for the Italian national team
quotes.excerpt: There is always been a lot of pressure on me to be part of the program.

text_blocks.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
text_blocks.text: There was a rule back in the days where if you say no, they disqualify you and they don't call you no more. The rule has changed, so now you can say no, but my fans and the whole country would not be very happy with me saying no. So there is always been a lot of pressure on me to be part of the program, part of the team, which I always wanted to. I played with the national team when I was a free agent, when my contract was on the line, when I was injured. I always said yes for the pleasure of being part of the program, but yes, because of the pressure and the fans and the whole thing, of course, saying no for me would have been a disaster.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: When the country's behind you, you better get your ass on that damn team.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: You better get on that floor.

quotes.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
quotes.summary_phrase: Gallinari explains the trade that brought Paul George to the Clippers
quotes.excerpt: They asked me, Lou Williams, and Patrick Beverley that year, what do we need?

text_blocks.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
text_blocks.text: They asked me, Lou Williams, and Patrick Beverley that year, what do we need? Because we overachieved, we went to the playoffs, so we were not far from being a playoff team and a contender. So they told us what do we need? And we all said, we need a superstar. We need one superstar, and we think we have a good team to be a contender. Months later, they told us, do you guys like Kawhi Leonard? And we said, fuck yeah. It would be a perfect fit for us, for the way that we want to play, the guys that we have, for how Doc Rivers likes to play. Kawhi was just perfect. So we were all excited because we were like, fuck, next year, same team with Kawhi, we good. And Kawhi, of course, it was in his prime, it was amazing. He's still amazing, but you know, injuries has been tougher for him.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: And you know, your teammate on that team, and we were going to talk about point guards in the first place, your favorite point guard is who?

text_blocks.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
text_blocks.text: Is Raymond Felton.

quotes.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
quotes.summary_phrase: Gallinari on the trade that sent him to Oklahoma City
quotes.excerpt: It was clearly a player request that didn't like what he saw.

text_blocks.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
text_blocks.text: That was the first time where I got traded not because of an owner or GM or coach situation or request. It was clearly a player request that didn't like what he saw. He wanted his friend or whatever relationship was there with Paul George, and so that was what I didn't like. I didn't say anything bad. I actually thought good about Kawhi, so I don't care. I got enough in my life and on my plate to worry about. I'm definitely not worried about Kawhi or whatever is going on with the Clippers or the NBA or the trade now with the Raptors.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Everything's cleared up, my brother. We appreciate you pulling up.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson and Raymond Felton discuss the best small forwards
quotes.excerpt: I don't know many small forwards that are better than him.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I'm a big-time Kawhi fan. I don't know many small forwards that are better than him.

text_blocks.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
text_blocks.text: No.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I can go tip-for-tat. You name a small forward, I'm putting them up there with him.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: I don't want to.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: I'm with you. I'm with you. Like, Kawhi Leonard, go down as one of the best small forwards in the game.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson and Raymond Felton debate Scottie Pippen vs. Carmelo Anthony
quotes.excerpt: If I'm starting a team, I'm picking Carmelo before Scottie Pippen.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: If I'm starting a team, I'm picking Carmelo before Scottie Pippen.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Yes.

text_blocks.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
text_blocks.text: You got an all-time team.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: This is before all this shit even happened. You get a Swiss Army knife. This is before all this shit even happened. You get a Swiss Army knife, but let's talk about it. Swiss Army knife? I understand. I said name you a better player right now. We're talking about Carmelo and Pippen.

text_blocks.speaker: Raymond Felton
text_blocks.text: Okay.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: Everything offensively is except for probably shooting is a wash. The only difference is Pippen probably is a better playmaker. Am I wrong? No.

text_blocks.speaker: Danilo Gallinari
text_blocks.text: No.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: No, you don't understand Melo. Come on, bro. Melo can pass the ball. Bro, just because he scored, that's what he wanted to do. That's what we needed him to do. But don't get it twisted. Melo can pass that rock, bro. I swear to you.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues Scottie Pippen was a superior two-way player to Carmelo Anthony
quotes.excerpt: Scotty Pippen is a first team all NBA three times. That means he was a part with Michael
quotes.quote: At the end of the day, Scotty Pippen is a first team all NBA three times. That means he was a part with Michael, clearly. He was first team all NBA. That don't got nothing to do with Michael Jordan.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson defends Scottie Pippen's legacy and impact on Michael Jordan's success
quotes.excerpt: Scotty Pippen has to be, Pippen has to get his proper respect. Not saying y'all to disrespect him.
quotes.quote: At the end of the day, Scotty Pippen has to be, Pippen has to get his proper respect. Not saying y'all to disrespect him. I'm just going to be, I'm a, I'm a, I'm a fight for my n****.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues Scottie Pippen is one of the greatest players of all time
quotes.excerpt: Scottie Pippen is one of the the best players ever to play the game.
quotes.quote: Scottie Pippen is one of the the best players ever to play the game, right? And he's one of the guys that I grew up, but I grew up watching. But at the end of the day, like, if I'm talking about how these questions are based, my top five, I'm going to slide, I'm going to slide Melo in in front.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson discusses the impact of Kevin Durant joining the Golden State Warriors
quotes.quote: At the end of the day, Stephen Curry, Draymond Green, Steve Kerr, Bob Myers, they knew they needed to get another person, Kevin Durant. But it had to be, it had to be Kevin Durant. It couldn't be Kawhi Leonard too. They knew the league was going to try to get better. Every team tries to get better every single year. So they did their job.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Theo Pinson argues Kevin Durant saved the Golden State Warriors dynasty
quotes.excerpt: Kevin Durant saved this Warriors dynasty. I don't know if Stephen Curry still there.
quotes.quote: Kevin Durant saved this Warriors dynasty. I don't know if Stephen Curry still there. I don't know if Draymond still there. I don't know if Steve Kerr is still coaching. Because what we see, this is what I'm, the reason I say this and hear me out, we know the league to panic. When you lose, people panic.
